visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A well-groomed Asian male in his late 20s with black hair and a black T-shirt stands against a dark grey studio background. He holds a triangular yellow Prada branded box with both hands, smiling brightly with visible teeth. The lighting is high-key studio lighting, creating clear skin textures and soft shadows. (2) The camera zooms in as the man opens the yellow box to reveal its contents: a silver Prada lip balm tube nestled inside. He looks directly at the camera with an enthusiastic expression, his eyes wide and engaging. (3) A series of quick cuts shows close-ups of the lip balm itself—first a light green version, then a light blue version, followed by the main yellow version. The silver casing reflects the bright studio lights. (4) The host brings the yellow lip balm to his nose, closing his eyes briefly as if to inhale the scent, then opens them and smiles widely at the camera while speaking. (5) The shot tightens to an extreme close-up of the host's mouth as he applies the yellow balm to his lower lip. His lips look hydrated and slightly glossy. (6) Returning to a medium close-up, the host continues to talk excitedly, gesturing with one hand while holding the product in the other. Cartoonish yellow banana icons and sparkle emojis briefly overlay the screen around him. (7) The host points to his lips, then holds the lip balm near his face, posing with a confident smile. Golden ray effects emanate from behind the product during the mention of 'success'. (8) The final phase shows the host in a polished pose, holding the Prada lip balm close to his cheek, with the 'PRADA BEAUTY' logo appearing clearly on the bottom of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the product with a bright, professional tone. Upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a consistent synth bassline starts immediately. (2) A 'whoosh' sound effect syncs with the box opening, followed by a slight increase in vocal arousal as the host reveals the silver tube. (3) Rapid 'pop' sound effects play during quick cuts between different product versions. BGM remains steady. (4) Host's breathing is subtly audible during the sniffing action, followed by a playful, rising vocal contour. (5) A 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' digital SFX rings out when the host mentions the 'champagne luster' of the balm. (6) High-pitched comic 'ding' SFX punctuates the joke about sales success. The host's voice becomes more emphatic and staccato. (7) Final summary is delivered with a friendly, closing cadence over a slightly fading but still rhythmic BGM track, ending with a crisp hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: An enthusiastic product unboxing and demonstration aimed at promoting the Prada Beauty yellow lip balm by highlighting its unique color-scent profile, moisturizing effect, and perceived lucky symbolic value for career success.
